_meta.description: Bank of England staff estimates of quarterly GDP growth (% q/q), as published in the Monetary Policy Report and the MPC minutes. Maintained by hand: add a row after each Report / minutes. Values are quoted from the Bank's own pages (url); 'note' says when a value is implied rather than stated.

estimates.note: Implied: the September minutes say Q2 GDP rose 0.4%, 0.1pp higher than expected in the July Report.
As quoted in the September 2026 minutes.
